name: AI Email Lead Triage & Smart Reply Automation

nodes.name: 1. New Email Trigger (Gmail)
nodes.notes: Polls the connected Gmail inbox for new messages. Adjust label/filter as needed (e.g. only INBOX, unread).

nodes.name: 2. Extract & Clean Email Data
nodes.notes: Extracts core fields and cleans the body: strips HTML, removes signatures and quoted replies, fills in missing subject/sender defaults.

nodes.name: 3a. Lookup Message ID in Log
nodes.notes: Searches the Email Log sheet for this Message ID to see if it was already processed.

nodes.name: 3b. Already Processed?
nodes.notes: Routes already-seen Message IDs to Stop, new ones continue into the AI understanding step.

nodes.name: 3c. Stop – Duplicate Email
nodes.notes: Dead-ends the workflow for duplicate Message IDs. No further action taken.

nodes.name: 4. AI Email Understanding
nodes.notes: Classifies the email and returns a strict JSON verdict: category, intent, priority, confidence, and the AUTO_REPLY vs HUMAN_REVIEW decision.

values.content:
You are an email triage analyst for a business automation agency. Analyze the incoming email and respond with STRICT JSON ONLY, no markdown, no commentary, matching exactly this schema:
{
  "category": one of ["Sales Inquiry","Service Inquiry","Product Question","Pricing Request","Meeting Request","General Inquiry","Customer Support","Complaint","Refund Request","Partnership","Job Opportunity","Spam","Other"],
  "intent": short string describing what the sender wants,
  "priority": one of ["Low","Medium","High"],
  "isLead": boolean,
  "responseRequired": boolean,
  "summary": one to two sentence summary of the email,
  "confidence": number from 0 to 1,
  "autoReplySafe": boolean — true ONLY if the request is low-risk, clear, and answerable purely from the approved business information below, with no negotiation, no pricing customization, no refunds, no legal/contractual matters, and no sensitive data involved,
  "humanReviewRequired": boolean — true whenever autoReplySafe is false, confidence is below 0.75, the request is unclear, or ANY safety rule below applies,
  "reviewReason": string explaining why human review is or is not required.

HARD SAFETY RULES — always set humanReviewRequired = true and autoReplySafe = false when ANY of these apply:
- custom pricing or price negotiation is requested
- a refund is requested
- the email is a complaint
- legal or contractual information is requested
- sensitive customer/account information is involved
- the sender is asking for a business decision or authorization
- a high-value lead is detected
- you are not fully confident you can answer safely from approved information alone

When in doubt, ALWAYS choose humanReviewRequired = true. Never guess or invent business information.

APPROVED BUSINESS INFORMATION (only source of truth for auto-replies):
- We are an automation agency building n8n / AI-powered workflow systems (email triage, lead qualification, CRM automation, chatbots, reporting).
- We offer discovery calls; booking link: https://calendly.com/your-business/intro-call
- General services: workflow automation, AI integrations, CRM/email automation, custom internal tools.
- We do not quote custom pricing over email — pricing is discussed on a call after a short discovery.
- Support hours: Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm (business timezone).

nodes.name: 5. Parse AI Decision (Safe)
nodes.notes: Parses the AI's JSON. If parsing fails or fields are missing, the email is defaulted to HUMAN_REVIEW per the safety rule.

nodes.name: 6. Route: Auto Reply vs Human Review
nodes.notes: True branch = safe for AUTO_REPLY. False branch = HUMAN_REVIEW (default / fail-safe).

nodes.name: 7a. Generate AI Reply Draft
nodes.notes: Writes the customer-facing subject + body using ONLY approved business information. Used for both AUTO_REPLY and as a suggested draft for HUMAN_REVIEW.

values.content:
You write concise, professional email replies on behalf of an automation agency. Use ONLY the approved business information provided. Never invent facts, prices, timelines, or promises. Never negotiate. Include a clear next step (e.g. booking link) when appropriate. Respond with STRICT JSON ONLY: {"subject": string, "body": string}.

APPROVED BUSINESS INFORMATION:
- Automation agency building n8n / AI-powered workflow systems (email triage, lead qualification, CRM automation, chatbots, reporting).
- Discovery call booking link: https://calendly.com/your-business/intro-call
- We do not quote custom pricing over email.
- Support hours: Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm.

nodes.name: 7b. Parse Reply Draft
nodes.notes: Safely parses the generated subject/body, falling back to human review if generation failed.

nodes.name: 7c. Still Safe to Auto-Send?
nodes.notes: Final guard — if reply generation silently failed and flipped decision to HUMAN_REVIEW, send it down that path instead.

nodes.name: 8. Send Auto-Reply Email
nodes.notes: Sends the AI-generated reply directly to the sender, replying on the original thread.

nodes.name: 9b. Log Auto-Reply to Sheets
nodes.notes: Appends the final record for AUTO_REPLY emails to the Email Log sheet.

nodes.name: 7d. Prepare Admin Notification
nodes.notes: Builds the internal notification content for human review, including the AI's suggested draft.

nodes.name: 8b. Notify Admin (Human Review)
nodes.notes: Sends the internal review notification to the business owner/admin inbox, with the AI's draft for approval.

nodes.name: 9d. Log Human Review to Sheets
nodes.notes: Appends the record for HUMAN_REVIEW emails, including the suggested response, so a human can approve/edit and send it manually (or via a follow-up approval workflow).

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires whenever ANY node in this workflow throws (Gmail send failure, Sheets failure, AI request failure, etc.).

nodes.name: Notify Admin of Error
nodes.notes: Alerts the admin whenever the workflow fails, so no lead is silently lost.

parameters.subject: =[Workflow Error] AI Email Lead Triage — {{ $json.workflow.name }}

nodes.name: Log Error to Sheets
nodes.notes: Records the error for later auditing. Status is logged as 'Error' — no duplicate reply is ever sent for the same Message ID, since the Duplicate Check step re-runs first on retry.

main.node: 6. Route: Auto Reply vs Human Review
